focus_areas: Scale texture consistency across the black/yellow boundary

image_description: A close-up, side-profile photograph of a Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor) against a dark background. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior body and tail. A distinct blue eye ring is visible. Behind the main subject, partially obscured, is the head of a second, darker fish.

To verify the integrity of the fin edges and ensure no 'melting' into the dark background, especially around the complex scale patterns.
